in_text_mentions: Despite fluid and electrolyte resuscitative efforts, the patient developed respiratory distress with severe respiratory and metabolic alkalosis (pH 7.8; pCO2 23.7 mmHg; lactate 0.2 mmol/L; HCO3 41 mmol/L). Emergency contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CECT) imaging was performed, which showed a left posterolateral diaphragmatic defect measuring 10.2 cm × 9.7 cm. The scan showed herniation of the colon, stomach, spleen, and pancreas and an organo-axial gastric volvulus, resulting in outlet obstruction, and an ectopic left kidney (Figures 2-4).
